summary:
Buy 31 ceiling air devices: 28 ceiling supply diffusers + 3 ceiling return grilles. All are Price (or approved equal), all new — M101 notes 2, 7, 8 and 9 all call for "new supply grille(s)" / "new grilles," so nothing is being reused.

CEILING SUPPLY DIFFUSERS — 28 total. Tags A–D are all the same product, Price SCD: louvered-face square 4-cone steel ceiling diffuser, white, fixed 4-way (360°) discharge, in a 24"x24" panel for lay-in ceiling, with a radial balancing damper in the neck (Price VCR9 or equal), NC ≤ 35. They differ only by neck size:
  • A — 6" round neck — 5 ea (75, 75, 75, 90, 130 CFM)
  • B — 8" round neck — 4 ea (150, 150, 140, 140 CFM)
  • C — 10" round neck — 15 ea (250, 200, 250, 250, 250, 200, 350, 350, 350, 300, 375, 375, 300, 375, 375 CFM)
  • D — 12" round neck — 1 ea (500 CFM, KILNS 115)
  • J — Price SMD, 12"x12" face with 8" round neck, white, 4-way, high-capacity louvered face, opposed-blade damper, FLANGED FRAME for surface mounting (hard ceiling, not lay-in) — 3 ea (175, 150, 150 CFM, in the toilet/shower area)
Total ceiling supply air = 6,550 CFM.

CEILING RETURN GRILLES — 3 total:
  • F — Price 80, 24"x24" core-only egg-crate (1/2"x1/2"x1/2" aluminum), white, in a 24x24 lay-in panel, NC ≤ 35 — 3 ea. No CFM scheduled. Per M101 note 4, provide a new 24"x24" lined (1/2" liner) plenum atop each one.

CEILING EXHAUST — do NOT order grilles for these. The three ceiling exhaust points (2 @ 450 CFM in the toilets, 1 @ 75 CFM) are Greenheck centrifugal ceiling exhaust fans EF-1/EF-2 (SPA-700) and EF-3 (SP-B90), which per the schedule come with an integral grille.

NOT CEILING — priced separately if your scope includes them: E (Price 95, 30x18, primecoat, heavy-duty sidewall return, 4 ea — note 7 says the engineer could not field-measure these, so field verify before ordering), G (Price 95, 36x36, primecoat, sidewall transfer grille at 14'-8" AFF, 4 ea), H (Price 520D, 18x8, double-deflection sidewall supply, 550 CFM ea, 3 ea), I (Price 520D, 14x8, double-deflection sidewall supply, 450 CFM ea, 4 ea). Also one 14"x14" egg-crate (Price model 82) mounted in a soffit with insect screen per M101 note 19 — soffit, not ceiling.

Coordination flags: M601 general note 3 requires ceiling register locations to be coordinated with the lighting layout, sprinkler heads and ceiling grid — check the architectural RCP before you set them. A/B/C/D and F are lay-in (24x24 module); J is surface-mount flanged, so confirm the ceiling type in the rooms it serves before ordering.

Sheets used: M601 (Mechanical Legend & Schedules — GRILLES schedule, EXHAUST FANS schedule, general notes), M101 (Mechanical New Work Floor Plan — device count, CFM, sheet notes 1–28), MD101 (Mechanical Demolition Floor Plan — confirmed no reused devices), M501 (Mechanical Details).
